_comment: A stand-in needs.product_ref catalogue for the launch-term rules (#285). Six refs over four brands, shaped after the seven sunscreens of the 2026-09-20 experiment: two brands hold two lines each (one pair where the shorter line name is contained in the longer one, which is the `partial` join the rule table gates on), one brand holds a single line, and one holds a product whose name is its brand plus the category word alone -- the refusal round one of the experiment measured.
